def VTask.prev {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ l) : α :=
  let i := (l.enumList).find hx |>.getD 0
  let n := l.length
  let wrap := if i = 0 then n - 1 else i - 1
  l.get wrap
